registration.comparison_disclosure: online methods share one decision-event cap; gradient budgets differ only through registered method UTD and pretraining protocols

host_gpu_concurrency.scheduling_rule: at most one canonical process per physical GPU; both GPUs on a registered server may run concurrently

same_gpu_capacity_gate.admission_rule: same-GPU sharing is disabled for current formal v7 plans; any future quota above one must pass this gate before formal training

deterministic_offline_prefix_reuse.scientific_accounting: each consumer inherits the exact same-seed 50000-update IQL trajectory registered for that branch; the prefix is physically executed once per seed and no evaluation outcome selects or alters the shared state

formal_policy_artifact.selection_rule: the completed final actor from every registered training seed; no held-out evaluation outcome may select a checkpoint

registration.online_budget_semantics: the simulator decision-event hard cap includes frozen-policy warmup; simultaneous decision batches remain atomic and a final batch that would exceed the cap is not run
registration.placement_disclosure: Every canonical v7 CUDA job executes only on registered GPU servers. H2O+ and its direct branches use the server-h2oplus execution class; RLPD, WSRL, SAC controls, offline controls, and ratio-SAC use the server-non-h2oplus execution class. Every method consumes the same admitted HDF5 and calibrated simulator; no formal v7 method reads the legacy snapshot corpus.
registration.primary_outcome: accrued generalized passenger seconds divided by departed passengers over the fixed 24000-second horizon
registration.statistical_unit: independent training seed evaluated on paired, disjoint SUMO scenario cells
